title: Strict integral mixed coefficient-tower equation
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E, F and G of Q_l, Q_l-algebra embeddings i : E → F and j : F → G, arbitrary schemes X and Y and a morphism g : X → Y. For every K in PbcCompletedDerived Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E), scalar extension from F to G of strict beta for i at K, followed by strict beta for j at scalar extension of K, followed by strict completed pullback of the scalar associator on Y, equals the scalar associator on X at strict completed pullback of K followed by strict beta for j composed with i. These are precisely rationalScalarStrictBeta and pbcAmbientScalarComp, with the quotient-normalized actual strict completed pullback.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, pp. 61–62; the completion-unit and scalar associativity calculation in the parent node, step 6 or 7.

proof.text: Invert the reflected coefficient-tower equation supplied by rationalScalarCompletionUnitSquare_coefficients. Substitute the definition of strict beta as conjugation by the actual ambient completion comparison. Naturality of that comparison moves it past the coefficient associator. Cancel the middle comparison and its inverse, then use naturality of the scalar associator to move the remaining outer comparison. The resulting equation is the claimed strict tower.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalMixedIntegralCoefficientTower
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    (pbcEmbeddingAmbientTensor l F G j X).map
        ((rationalScalarStrictBeta l E F i g).hom.app K) ≫
      (rationalScalarStrictBeta l F G j g).hom.app
        ((pbcEmbeddingAmbientTensor l E F i Y).obj K) ≫
      (pbcActualStrictCompletedPull (pbcIntegralDatum l G) g).map
        ((pbcAmbientScalarComp l E F G i j Y).hom.app K) =
    (pbcAmbientScalarComp l E F G i j X).hom.app
        ((pbcActualStrictCompletedPull (pbcIntegralDatum l E) g).obj K) ≫
      (rationalScalarStrictBeta l E G (j.comp i) g).hom.app K
